name: Pink 360 Desk Organizer Stationery Set
shortDescription: A pink kawaii desk organizer set with a rotating pen cup, tape dispenser, stapler, scissors, clips, and small stationery pieces for tidy study and craft spaces.
longDescription: This pink 360 desk organizer stationery set is made for anyone who wants a cute but practical way to keep pens, pencils, markers, clips, tape, and small desk tools in one easy-to-reach place. The product photos show a pink rotating pen organizer filled with stationery, plus matching accessories such as a stapler, tape dispenser, scissors, binder clips, paper clips, and small sticky notes. It is a nice pick for study desks, journaling setups, craft corners, home offices, and gift baskets where the desk tools should feel soft, organized, and aesthetic. Before publishing or buying, confirm the exact included pieces, dimensions, and color option on the Amazon listing.
